newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Most polling stations close in Algeria election.
newsitem.headline: Most polling stations close in Algeria election.

text.p: Most polling stations closed across Algeria at 7 p.m. (1800 GMT) on Thursday but voting in the country's general elections was extended by an hour at some stations because of high voter turnout.
Interior Minister Mustapha Benmansour told a news conference that the election was held in ''very fine'' conditions and said turnout stood at 56.02 percent by 6 p.m. (1700 GMT).
''I repeat that the operation took place...until now in very fine conditions,'' Benmansour said.

He said voting hours were extended at some polling stations, including the capital Algiers, to accommodate large numbers of voters still trying to cast ballots. Turnout in Algiers was the lowest in the country at 3 p.m.
The minister said that later on Thursday evening he would set a time for announcing the final results.
